verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.tryardent.com that indexes the docs as markdown files (index.md, quickstart.md, cli/*.md), and a second llms.txt exists at tryardent.com. The docs are also agent-oriented: the ardent-cli skill fetches the current docs to drive setup, and a dedicated AI-agents workflow page explains how an agent should use the product. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content bundle, and no independent or hands-on report of an agent consuming the docs successfully.
